name: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled is a retro-style arcade shooter that puts you in the horns of a devilish hero armed with a harpoon gun. Burst bouncing bubbles that split on impact, dodge with precision, and grab power-ups across tricky platform-filled levels.
